text: 中国财政部周三公告，在香港发行了规模150亿元人民币主权债，其中2年期、15年期和30年期品种发行利率均创新低。3年期和5年期发行利率刷新2011年以来最低水平。5只人民币主权债的整体认购倍数4.67倍，为2025年6月来最高。发行2年期50亿元，发行利率1.27%；3年期40亿元，发行利率1.30%；5年期40亿元，发行利率1.43%；15年期10亿元，发行利率1.99%；30年期10亿元，发行利率2.24%。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance announced on Wednesday that it issued RMB 15 billion in sovereign bonds in Hong Kong, with record-low issuance rates for 2-year, 15-year, and 30-year tranches. The 3-year and 5-year tranches saw rates at their lowest since 2011. The overall subscription ratio for the five renminbi sovereign bonds was 4.67 times, the highest since June 2025. The 2-year tranche was RMB 5 billion at 1.27%, the 3-year at RMB 4 billion at 1.30%, the 5-year at RMB 4 billion at 1.43%, the 15-year at RMB 1 billion at 1.99%, and the 30-year at RMB 1 billion at 2.24%.
